items.title: IFF shares fall on soft 2026 guidance despite Q3 beat
items.summary: Investing.com -- International Flavors & Fragrances Inc (NYSE:IFF) reported third-quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations, but shares fell 3% in after-hours trading Tuesday as the company's raised full-year guidance disappointed investors.

items.title: International Flavors & Fragrances’s (NYSE:IFF) Q3 2026 sales top estimates
items.summary: Flavor and fragrance producer IFF (NYSE:IFF) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue rising 3.9% year on year to $1.94 billion. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $7.55 billion at the midpoint came in 0.5% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.83 per share was 1.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Sensient Sinks 12% as Revenue Miss and Unchanged Outlook Overshadow Earnings Beat
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSensient shares fell 12% today as third-quarter revenue came in just short of estimates, though earnings per share beat. The beat didn’t lift the top of Sensient’s 2026 earnings range, and after a gain of about 40% this year, investors wanted more.
